label: AN5516-01 OLT
description: Fiberhome AN5516-01 large-capacity OLT, 11U 19-inch chassis with 16 service slots and a 3.2 Tbit/s backplane, up to 256 GPON ports. This spec models one GCOB 16-port GPON card (gpon1/1-16) plus one HU2A uplink card: 2x 10GE in XFP cages (XG1-2) and 2 combo GE optical/electrical positions (GE3-4, each counted as an RJ45 + SFP pair) = 22 ports. The 10G ports are XFP, not SFP+: a different, larger cage that an SFP+ module does not fit.
notes: HU2A is 2x10GE + 2xGE per FiberHome (XG1-2 are 10GE uplink optical, GE3-4 are GE optical/electrical). 10GE modules for this board are XFP (10G-10km/40km/80km tdM-XFP), so the cages are xfp and the engine refuses an SFP+ optic in them - the same refusal a technician would get. Other uplink boards in the family: HU1A/HU1B (4GE + 1x10GE), GU6F (6xGE). Chassis maximum is 16 service slots / 256 GPON ports, which this spec does not populate - one GCOB and one HU2A are counted.
